In docs/docs/flink-maintenance.md, add documentation for the new ExpireSnapshotsConfig and DeleteOrphanFilesConfig classes and the config(...) builder methods on ExpireSnapshots.Builder and DeleteOrphanFiles.Builder, plus the TableMaintenance.Builder.add(Collection) overload and the new maintenance(...) wiring on the sink.
In docs/docs/flink-maintenance.md DeleteOrphanFiles Configuration table, update the usePrefixListing default from False to True to match the changed default.
